# Play — Centre of Gravity

- SudokuPad: [Centre of Gravity on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Centre of Gravity on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Seesaws are an invented rule, so neither site knows them. They are exported as plain brown lines with a white circle
on the fulcrum, and the full rule is in the rules text.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (givens, constraints with `pivot` cells, solution).
